description: Khorulan wears a long deep navy noble coat with broad gold woven scroll and geometric borders along the front edges, collar, cuffs and lower hem. An ivory linen tunic beneath has dark blue embroidered neckline and long center panel. A broad dark leather belt carries oval metal fittings and a long decorated hanging end. Dark trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. Both hands hang naturally at his sides and both feet are fully visible. The fabric is thick, opaque and layered. No headgear, armor, weapon or extravagant fur mantle appears.
